title: Miles Per Gallon to L/100km Instant Calculator
metaDescription: Convert Miles Per Gallon (US & UK) to Liters per 100 Kilometers (L/100km) with inverse fuel efficiency calculation formula and comparison charts.
directAnswer: To convert Miles Per Gallon (US MPG) to Liters per 100 Kilometers (L/100km), divide 235.215 by the MPG figure. For example, 30 US MPG equals 7.84 L/100km, while 40 MPG equals 5.88 L/100km. Because this is an inverse relationship, lower L/100km ratings indicate superior fuel efficiency, whereas higher MPG numbers indicate lower fuel consumption.

faq.question: What is 30 MPG in L/100km?
faq.answer: 30 US MPG is approximately 7.84 Liters per 100 kilometers (Formula: 235.214583 ÷ 30 = 7.84).

faq.question: Why is MPG to L/100km an inverse conversion?
faq.answer: Because MPG measures distance per volume of fuel (higher is better), whereas L/100km measures fuel consumed over distance (lower is better).

faq.question: How do you convert Imperial UK MPG to L/100km?
faq.answer: Divide 282.481 by the UK MPG number (Formula: 282.481 ÷ UK MPG = L/100km) because British gallons contain 4.546 liters.
